The structure of composition Mo₆Ru₄ (reduced formula Mo₃Ru₂) crystallizes in the cubic space group F-43m (No. 216), with 20 atoms per unit cell distributed across 3 independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-only CrystalNN analysis identifies close-packed-like local arrangements: Mo centers have 12 geometric neighbors (8 Mo, 4 Ru) and Ru centers have 12 Mo neighbors, while Ru–Ru pairs show 12 neighbors each, with neighbor distances near 2.722 Å. The geometric neighbor graph is 3-dimensional and connected across all 20 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing contacts include corner, edge, and face sharing between Mo-centered 12-vertex polyhedra, and corner and face sharing between Mo- and Ru-centered polyhedra.
